ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Community Care
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description:
WIL'S COMMUNITY CARE (early development)
Careers in care for Wil's Community Framework: anyone can be assigned as a Healer (a Nurse once the community has a Doctor), qualified Doctors run check-up rounds in the medical room, visits those too ill to travel, calls an outbreak round when many fall ill, and gives a modest, short-lived edge against illness to those who are seen. A check-up never treats anyone: emergencies and ongoing care come first.
Requires Wil's Community Framework, which provides the family records, the community posts and everything this module plugs into. It does not need Wil's Role Modules : Education and works without it.
Load it after Wil's Community Framework. If you take it out of a game, use the developer action "Prepare Community Care for removal" first (see the installation notes); the mod's own records stay in the save and are picked up again if you add it back.
Created by Spaceman_Wil. Uses Harmony by Andreas Pardeike.
